gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Tubular, wire-like letterforms give College its look, every curve as stout as a straight stem, while Noto Sans Lepcha sits beneath in a lowercase that stands tall. Lines of it read smoothly on a plain sans frame.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-limbu: College is a skeleton outline given one fixed stroke thickness, tall and authoritative up top, with Noto Sans Limbu beneath it, its curves gaping wide. A longer passage in it would feel easy and plain sans.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-lydian: College works like a steel cable bent into letters, with no thick-thin shift anywhere in it. And Noto Sans Lydian brings capitals barely taller than its lowercase, which gives the pairing a level, agreeable stance.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Stout, swell-free letters up top. College keeps its bowls free of any swelling and is at its best shouting from a heading, while Noto Sans Mahajani, with a funnel-wide e, does its best work in running text.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-malayala: Signage-plain and sturdy, with crossbars matching the stems. College holds its heading with a tall lowercase, while Noto Sans Malayalam, with its middle zone dominating each line, would look a little lost if the heading shrank small.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: College draws uninterrupted monoline strokes with big counters in a tall lowercase, set against Noto Sans Mandaic's curvy, unclamped letters. It earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads with proud, almost capital-sized small letters and curves that end in clear daylight. And College, built from a ribbon of constant width, lets that text keep running smoothly on a plain sans footing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nu: Plain as a road sign, College keeps every line weight the same, with big counters in a tall lowercase over Noto Sans Mayan Numerals. Both stand tall and open, and that tallness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-medefaid: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads with a lowercase that rises high and curves that turn in without any ink pooling. And College, with no hairline-to-stem shift, keeps a long passage flowing in the same open, steady way.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-meetei-m: College is dynamic and authoritative, with diagonals as thick as its uprights. Its strongest quality is the push against Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, whose rounds gap like a cracked bangle and whose lowercase eyes run large.
